NCR holdout (formerly) |rank =Ranger |TV actor =[[Jon Gries]] }} '''Ranger Biff''' is a member of the [[New California Republic Rangers]] in [[Fallout TV series season 2|season two]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== Ranger Biff is one of the last remaining holdouts of the [[New California Republic]] in the [[Mojave Wasteland]], having remained guarding against [[Caesar's Legion]] since the [[Fall of Shady Sands]] and their subsequent loss of communication with other NCR forces in the region. Together with [[Rodriguez|Captain Rodriguez]] and another veteran Ranger, the trio have been camped at an [[NCR outpost|outpost]] near [[Primm]] as of 2296. Biff has been passing the time by caring for a pet [[squirrel]]. Around July 2296, the group decides to pack up their outpost and leave to avoid being captured by the Legion.{{FOTV|2|4}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Profligate]]=== After receiving a tip from [[Victor (Securitron)|Victor]] at [[Camp Golf]] about "Rangers in the hills," the Ghoul leaves in search of the Rangers, hoping to enlist their firepower to help rescue [[Lucy MacLean]], who had been captured by the Legion. Outside Primm, he approaches the NCR outpost and is ambushed by the trio, with Biff standing to the back while Rodriguez and the other Ranger ascertain whether the Ghoul is a threat. After the Ghoul is brought to the camp, Biff is seen with his helmet off, tending to his squirrel and muttering that they have to be ready for the rest of the NCR to return "any day now." When Rodriguez tells the Ghoul that they have been isolated for over a decade, he affirms that he believes reinforcements will come, though both Rodriguez and the Ghoul acknowledge that Biff has been left particularly disheveled by the isolation. The Ghoul tells Rodriguez that Shady Sands' destruction was a long time ago, meaning that any reinforcements they knew of from back then may no longer exist; Biff looks up forlornly as a result. He continues listening to their conversation, backing Rodriguez' claim that the NCR is winning against the Legion. When the Ghoul refuses to help them fend off the Legion, Biff glares as he leaves, but remains seated. ===[[The Demon in the Snow]]=== Biff is seen at the NCR outpost as Lucy wakes up from her recovery. Lucy is taken aback when she first sees Biff tending to his squirrel, and when she asks whether there are any more NCR remnants, Biff adamantly maintains that there are "tons" of them, just not there at the moment. He then asks whether Lucy has been to Shady Sands, telling her that they came from there, while helping Rodriguez pack up supplies. He later thanks Lucy when she calls it a "welcome change of pace" to have met them compared to others in the wasteland. He continues to switch between packing and playing with the squirrel as Lucy talks with Rodriguez. ===[[The Other Player]]=== While travelling, Biff was abducted by [[Hank MacLean]]'s mind-controlled slaves and taken to the [[Las Vegas management Vault]], along with a [[Massive legionary|legionary]], and both were fitted with [[brain-computer interface chip]]s. When Lucy is about to take her father to the surface to face justice, Biff and the legionary are wheeled out by the [[snake oil salesman]] and another slave, tied to desk chairs. The salesman asks Hank what to do with them since they have not been "fixed" yet, but Hank defers to Lucy to decide whether to activate the chip with the push of a button or let them free. Lucy chooses to let them free, but the legionary, who is the first of the two to be tied, immediately attempts to kill Biff. Lucy steps in to protect Biff from the legionary but is eventually overtaken. Biff attempts to keep the legionary away, only for the legionary to begin hitting him in the head with a stapler. Lucy pleads for Hank to stop them, but Hank answering that the only way to stop them is to hit the button to activate their chips. With Biff being assaulted and no way to stop the legionary, Lucy chooses to hit the button. Biff and the legionary are near-instantly brainwashed, losing all of their previous animosity and their memories of what had happened, with the legionary helping untie Biff and leading him away to receive medical attention. ==Personality== Biff is initially shown to be constantly on edge as a result of over a decade of combat in the Mojave. Despite this, his faith in his mission remains strong; he shares [[Rodriguez]]' belief that the NCR is still active, and that they are winning the war against the Legion, though neither claim's validity is certain. After being captured by Hank MacClean and implanted with a [[brain-computer interface chip]], however, he was brainwashed into becoming a model Vault-Tec employee willing to work with the captured [[Massive legionary|legionary]] he'd been fighting shortly beforehand. ==Appearances== Biff appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|11=203|12=204|14=206|15=207}} ==Behind the scenes== Biff's Ranger combat armor is seen to have additional shoulder armor, which makes it somewhat resemble [[riot gear]]. ==Gallery== FTV S2E3 Still 230.png FTV S2E3 Still 234.png FTV S2E3 Still 235.png FTV S2E3 Still 240.png FTV S2E4 Still 087.png FTV S2E4 Still 088.png FTV S2E4 Still 089.png FTV S2E4 Still 096.png ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:New California Republic Rangers characters]]
